source_title: 第一章〈鐵盒〉開頭的追逐
changes: 刪減：小滿撞翻一疊塑膠凳的一句沒有拍
改動：原文「退進人群」改成退進攤車之間的暗處，避免生成人群
改動：掙脫與袖子撕裂不拍過程，用撕裂聲與鐵盒落地的結果帶過

plan.purpose: 小滿差點被搶走鐵盒，靠運氣脫身。觀眾知道鐵盒對雙方都重要，也知道她保不了它太久
beats: 小滿抱著鐵盒逃進夜市
雨衣男抓住她，要她交出東西
她掙脫，鐵盒掉進攤車底下
她撈回鐵盒，發現盒蓋凹了
plan.blocking: 小滿從巷口往巷子深處跑，雨衣男從後面追上，在兩排攤車之間抓住她：男人在巷口那一側，小滿在深處那一側，軸線沿著巷子。鐵盒掉在兩人之間，滾進深處那一側的攤車底下。哨聲從巷口外傳來，男人往攤車之間的暗處退走
plan.mood: 濕、擠，霓虹色對深藍的陰影；節奏先急後停，高點是全場最安靜的地方

setups.desc: 巷子入口，沿著巷子朝磚牆方向拍：兩排攤車的縱深。人物朝遠離鏡頭的方向跑
setups.bg: two rows of food carts with canvas awnings receding down the lane toward a brick wall, strings of bare bulbs overhead, wet asphalt

setups.desc: 兩台攤車之間，側面拍：男人在畫面左、小滿在畫面右。軸線在兩人之間，鏡頭在靠巷子入口的一側
setups.bg: the side of a food cart with a canvas awning, out-of-focus warm bulbs behind

setups.desc: 地面高度，朝攤車底下拍：鐵盒掉落的位置
setups.bg: the dark underside of a food cart, one wheel at the left edge of the frame, wet asphalt with neon reflections
setups.light: a strip of red neon reflected on the asphalt in the foreground, the underside of the cart in deep shadow

shots.action: 雨中的夜市巷子，鏡頭從燈泡的高度降到攤車的高度
shots.sound: steady rain drumming on canvas awnings, a pan sizzling somewhere down the lane
shots.frame: the lane runs straight away from the camera, vanishing point in the centre of the frame
shots.end: the camera has lowered to cart height and looks straight down the lane
shots.motion: rain falls steadily through the light of the bulbs, the canvas awnings ripple in the wind, reflections shimmer on the wet asphalt
shots.continuity: 建立鏡頭：巷子的走向是遠離鏡頭；之後人物都朝畫面右或遠離鏡頭的方向跑

shots.source: 「小滿抱著那只鐵盒從巷口衝出來」
shots.action: 小滿的腳踩過積水，從畫面左跑向畫面右

cast.partial: a pair of white canvas sneakers and bare shins in mid-stride, entering from the left edge of the frame
cast.pos: low in the left third of the frame, moving toward frame right

shots.bg: wet asphalt with red and blue neon reflections, cart wheels out of focus in the background
shots.light: low warm light from the left, neon colours reflected in the puddle
shots.frame: a shallow puddle in the centre of the frame, shallow depth of field
shots.end: the sneakers have left through the right edge of the frame, ripples spreading in the puddle
shots.motion: the sneakers land in the puddle one after the other and carry on out of the right edge of the frame, water splashing up and settling into ripples
shots.risk: 奔跑：只拍腳，兩步就出畫；速度靠 1.5 秒的短鏡頭和前後的剪接

shots.action: 小滿抱著鐵盒沿巷子跑遠，身後有更重的腳步聲
shots.sound: her footsteps fading down the lane, heavier footsteps approaching from behind the camera, rain

cast.pos: seen from behind in the centre of the frame, mid-stride, moving away from the camera down the lane
cast.hands: both arms wrapped around {P01} in front of her, elbows showing at her sides

shots.frame: the girl is small in the middle of the frame, the two rows of carts lead the eye toward her
shots.end: the girl with the short black bob is farther down the lane and smaller in the frame
shots.motion: the girl with the short black bob jogs away from the camera down the lane at a steady pace, her hood bouncing on her back; rain falls through the light of the bulbs
shots.risk: 奔跑：背影全景、只拍兩秒，寫成穩定的小跑；腿部變形就縮短到 1.5 秒，或改用 002 那種腳步插入鏡頭
shots.continuity: 小滿雙手抱著鐵盒；和 001 同機位，背景沿用 001 結束時的畫面

shots.source: 「穿雨衣的男人伸手抓住她的後領」
shots.action: 小滿鑽進攤車之間，一隻手從後面伸向她的帽兜
shots.sound: rain on canvas, two people breathing hard

cast.pos: in the right half of the frame, body in profile facing frame right, leaning forward mid-step
cast.hands: both arms hugging {P01} to her chest
cast.face: lips parted, breathing hard, brows drawn together

cast.partial: a large hand in a dark green rubber raincoat sleeve reaching in from the left edge of the frame toward the girl's hood, fingers open
cast.pos: at shoulder height in the left third of the frame

shots.frame: the girl's head in the upper right third of the frame, open space behind her on the left for the hand to enter
shots.end: the hand in the green sleeve is a few centimetres from the hood of the girl with the short black bob, who has taken one more step toward frame right
shots.motion: the girl with the short black bob takes one more step toward frame right, shoulders rising with her breath; the hand in the green sleeve reaches steadily closer to her hood
shots.risk: 肢體接觸：這一鏡停在抓到之前，下一鏡直接切到抓住之後，不拍接觸的瞬間
shots.continuity: 運動方向：左到右。軸線：男人在畫面左、小滿在畫面右

shots.action: 雨衣男抓著小滿的帽兜，低頭開口
shots.sound: rain pattering on the rubber hood

cast.pos: filling the centre of the frame, facing the camera, head tilted down
cast.gaze: looking down toward the lower right of the frame
cast.hands: right fist closed around a bunch of brick-red sweatshirt fabric at the lower right edge of the frame, left arm down at his side below the frame
cast.face: jaw set, eyes narrowed, rainwater dripping from the brim of the hood

shots.bg: a dark canvas awning overhead and blurred warm bulbs behind his hood
shots.light: warm bulbs behind him as a rim light on the hood, his face lit from below by red neon reflected off the wet ground
shots.frame: his face in the upper half of the frame, shallow depth of field
shots.end: the tall man in the green raincoat has finished speaking, mouth closed, head still tilted down
shots.motion: the tall man in the green raincoat tilts his head down a little further and speaks, rain dripping steadily from the brim of his hood; his fist stays closed on the red fabric
shots.risk: 口型：原生音訊，一鏡只說一句短話；臉朝鏡頭、頭部動作小
shots.continuity: 接觸之後：他的右拳抓著小滿的帽兜，小滿在畫面外的右下方；軸線不變，他看向畫面右。仰拍：他佔上風

shots.source: 「袖子裂開，鐵盒掉在地上，滾進攤車底下」
shots.action: 布料撕裂聲中，鐵盒掉在地上，滾進攤車底下
shots.sound: fabric tearing, then the tin clanging on asphalt and rattling to a stop
shots.props: {P01} in mid-air at the top of the frame, falling
shots.frame: the gap under the cart in the right half of the frame
shots.end: {P01} lies flat on the wet asphalt in the shadow under the cart
shots.motion: {P01} drops in from the top of the frame, lands on its edge on the wet asphalt, rolls under the cart and tips over flat, water rippling around it
shots.risk: 掙脫與撕裂是高風險動作，不拍過程：用撕裂聲加鐵盒落地的結果帶過
shots.continuity: 從這一鏡之後小滿換成 C01-b（右袖從肩線裂開）；鐵盒在攤車底下

shots.action: 兩個人僵住，同時低頭看向攤車底下
shots.sound: rain, the last rattle of the tin dying away

cast.pos: in the left half of the frame, body in profile facing frame right, right arm still half raised
cast.gaze: head turned down toward the lower right of the frame
cast.hands: right hand open and empty in front of him, left hand at his side
cast.face: brows raised, mouth a hard line

cast.pos: in the right half of the frame, half turned back toward frame left, one step away from the man
cast.gaze: head turned down toward the lower right of the frame
cast.hands: both hands open and empty in front of her chest

shots.frame: a clear gap of empty space between the two figures in the centre of the frame
shots.end: both figures hold still; the tall man in the green raincoat has lowered his right arm
shots.motion: the tall man in the green raincoat and the girl with the short black bob both stand frozen, looking down toward the lower right; his raised arm lowers, her shoulders rise and fall with her breath, rain keeps falling between them
shots.risk: 雙人同框、兩張臉都入鏡：兩人都是側臉、中間留空、幾乎不動；做不穩就拆成兩個特寫，各自低頭看向同一個方向
shots.continuity: 視線匹配：兩人都看向畫面右下，對應下一鏡攤車底下的鐵盒；小滿雙手已空，右袖裂開

shots.action: 攤車底下的鐵盒，雨水滴在盒蓋上；遠處響起哨聲
shots.sound: rain dripping on the tin lid, then a sharp whistle blast far away
shots.props: {P01} lying flat on the wet asphalt in the shadow under the cart
shots.frame: the tin in the centre of the frame
shots.end: the framing is slightly tighter on the tin, a bead of water running across its lid
shots.motion: raindrops land on the lid of the tin and run off its edge, the neon reflection on the asphalt wavers; everything else stays still
shots.continuity: 高點：全場最長的一鏡，升格讓雨滴變慢，時間像停住；沒有人、沒有動作，只有雨聲；結尾的哨聲帶出下一鏡

shots.action: 雨衣男朝哨聲的方向看了一眼，退進攤車之間的暗處

cast.pos: standing in the centre of the frame between two carts, body turned three-quarters toward the camera
cast.gaze: head turned toward frame left, toward the sound
cast.hands: both hands lowered at his sides

shots.bg: the dark gap between two food carts behind him, a canvas awning above
shots.light: warm bulb light on his front, deep shadow in the gap behind him
shots.frame: the dark gap fills the centre of the frame behind him
shots.end: the tall man in the green raincoat is two steps back inside the dark gap, only the outline of the raincoat catching the light
shots.motion: the tall man in the green raincoat glances toward frame left, then takes two unhurried steps backward into the dark gap between the carts, the light sliding off his raincoat
shots.risk: 原文是退進人群，人群是高風險，改成退進暗處；只退兩步，幅度小

shots.source: 「小滿跪在積水裡，把鐵盒撈出來。盒蓋上多了一道凹痕」
shots.action: 小滿跪在積水裡，抱著撈回來的鐵盒，看著盒蓋上的凹痕
shots.sound: the rain easing, water dripping from the awning, her unsteady breathing

cast.pos: kneeling in the centre of the frame beside a cart wheel, upper body facing the camera, shoulders hunched
cast.gaze: looking down at the lid of the tin in her hands
cast.hands: both hands holding {P01} in front of her chest, right thumb resting on a fresh dent across its lid
cast.face: brows pinched, lower lip caught between her teeth

shots.bg: a cart wheel and wet asphalt beside her, blurred warm bulbs far behind
shots.frame: her face in the upper middle of the frame, the tin just below it
shots.end: the framing is wider: the girl with the short black bob is small in the frame, kneeling alone in the puddle between the carts, the empty lane stretching behind her
shots.motion: the girl with the short black bob runs her right thumb once along the dent in the lid, blinks, and lets out a breath that lowers her shoulders; rain drips from the edge of the awning beside her
shots.risk: 手拿小物件：不拍撈的過程，從已經抱在手上開始；只動拇指
shots.continuity: 鐵盒蓋上多了一道凹痕；小滿是 C01-b；拉遠是這場戲的收尾，她一個人留在畫面裡
